rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a public festival or fair.

example.english: The neighborhood fete attracted many families.
example.traditional: 區內個嘉年華吸引咗好多家庭嚟玩。
example.jyutping: keoi1 noi6 go3 gaa1 nin4 waa4 kap1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 gaa1 ting4 lai4 waan2

rows.note: Use this when the festival is explicitly a charity event.

example.english: The school's charity fete donated all its proceeds to charity this year.
example.traditional: 學校今年搞嘅慈善嘉年華，收入全數捐畀慈善機構。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 gam1 nin4 gaau2 ge3 ci4 sin6 gaa1 nin4 waa4 sau1 jap6 cyun4 sou3 gyun1 bei2 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3

rows.note: Use this when the fete mainly involves selling goods to raise money for charity.

example.english: The community held a charity fete, raising money by selling homemade food.
example.traditional: 社區舉辦慈善義賣會，靠賣自製食品籌款。
example.jyutping: se5 keoi1 geoi2 baan6 ci4 sin6 ji6 maai6 wui5 kaau3 maai6 zi6 zai3 sik6 ban2 cau4 fun2
